purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S0-02-TOLX001, S0-02-QTM2. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: Branch D (A45 (c) / PA-4), one invocation: T0r c10_s0_02_tolx001_2p0 (run_0067 deck with IR.TOL / CR.TOLER x0.01 in both METHOD phases, 3600 s), then T2a c10_s0_02_qtm2_2p0 (run_0066 form, QTY points 0.5 -> 0.25 nm, enclosure kept, 1800 s).

Read-out: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/branch_d_readout.py T0r <T0r run dir> results/runs/run_0067_2p0_c10_s0_02_2p0 and branch_d_readout.py T2a <T2a run dir> results/runs/run_0066_2p0_c10_s0_02_2p0. Claims allowed and not allowed: A45 (c).
T2a out of memory ("Error: Memory allocation failure" in deckbuild.out): T2b is not run (the gate skips campaign_C10_Dmesh_T2b); UNRESOLVED.
Every launch counts; a failed, out-of-memory or timed-out launch is recorded UNRESOLVED and kept; no repeat, no factor or tolerance change, no repair (PA-19 v3: D/E are not repaired or repeated).

Outputs are not sealed (not state-only); read only for the registered read-out and the manual checks (manual_checks.md); no worst-set floor-window reading (magnitude, flatness or dI_D) from QTNLSC or FNORD before the registered convergence conditions (A45 (d) (a)); no H-C verdict; no transfer to other films or oxide sets.
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans
register_amendment: A47 (2026-10-15; A45 (c) PA-4 and A45 (d) PA-5 entries, read-out script and order; no Codex review, D-63): invoke only after A47 and its decision row are logged, with the go for THIS launch (Claude under D-59), immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_de.py has exited 0 naming this plan
launch_command: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml"; <project venv python> scripts/run_campaign.py config/campaign_C10_Dmesh.json   (PowerShell, package root, immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_de.py exited 0 naming this plan; no --retry; IWO_ATLAS_VIEWERS unset)

runs.label: c10_s0_02_tolx001_2p0
overrides: solver.method_base=newton trap maxtraps=10 itlimit=80 climit=1e-6 ir.tol=1e-21
runs.purpose: Tunnelling-mesh branch D, T0r (register A45 (c) / PA-4): fixed-tolerance replay of S0-02 exactly as launched in run_0067 (QTNLSC worst set, automatic slicing, S/D exclude_near, registered mesh) with IR.TOL 1e-19 -> 1e-21 on both METHOD lines, strict CR.TOLER 1e-17 -> 1e-19 and relaxed CR.TOLER 5e-18 -> 5e-20 (x0.01 in both phases); nothing else changes. Diagnostic only (branch_d_readout.py against run_0067).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: no physics prediction (a numerical diagnostic): pointwise dlog10|I_G| vs run_0067 at common V_G; points below ir.tol 1e-19 A/um or on inverted |I_G| steps are unresolved, never removed; stable only with a nonempty support, every resolved point within 0.1 dec and no unresolved required point (A45 (c))

runs.label: c10_s0_02_qtm2_2p0
runs.purpose: Tunnelling-mesh branch D, T2a (register A45 (c) / PA-4): the run_0066 form (QT mesh, no S/D exclude_near) with the QTY point spacing halved, 0.5 -> 0.25 nm, at the kept enclosure y = -0.0005 / 0.0175 um; slices 0.2 um; device mesh, models and tolerances unchanged. Post-processed T(E) cross-check under a declared KCL waiver (KCL failed in run_0066); branch_d_readout.py against run_0066.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: no physics prediction (a numerical diagnostic): dlog10|I_G| vs run_0066 within 0.1 dec -> "post-processed T(E) stable under this QT-mesh perturbation"; bit-identical output -> "QT-mesh activation not demonstrated" (UNRESOLVED); out of memory -> UNRESOLVED, T2b not run
